note: RFC 9180 known answers for DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) + HKDF-SHA256 with AES-128-GCM (aead_id 1, the suite of RFC 9180 appendix A.1) and AES-256-GCM (aead_id 2, the suite used by this protocol). The fields mode..enc are the official CFRG test vectors (github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke, test-vectors.json). The two accumulated values replace the long encryption and export lists; they come from the Go standard library (src/crypto/hpke/testdata/rfc9180.json, BSD licence) and are computed as described in "accumulated".

accumulated.source: SHAKE128 with empty input, read as a byte stream: each draw reads one length byte n, then n bytes
accumulated.encryptions: With one sender and one recipient context: 1000 times draw aad, then draw plaintext; ct = sender.Seal(aad, plaintext) (sequence numbers 0..999); recipient.Open must return plaintext. Absorb every ct into a second SHAKE128; encryptions_accumulated is its first 16 output bytes
accumulated.exports: For L = 0..999: draw exporter_context; value = Export(exporter_context, L) (both sides equal); absorb value into a second SHAKE128; exports_accumulated is its first 16 output bytes
accumulated.derandomizedEncap: The ephemeral key pair is DeriveKeyPair(ikmE); skRm/pkRm equal DeriveKeyPair(ikmR)
